quoted_tweet.author: OpenAI
quoted_tweet.text:
OpenAI models helped researchers—operating as part of our Patch the Planet initiative—discover critical security flaws in PHP, an open-source programming language used to run an estimated 70% of websites.

Over the past two months, we led a coalition of maintainers, researchers, and security providers to prepare fixes and protections ahead of disclosure. This duration was necessary because the fix was quite intricate and required a major change to the PHP engine. Every site using PHP can now safely upgrade their version to stay secure, in addition to applying mitigations from various security vendors.

Due to the severity of these flaws and PHP’s widespread use, we consider this bug to be one of the most impactful vulnerabilities in recent memory. It also marks a new phase, where AI can find security bugs with internet-scale impact. 

This is an example of the Defender’s Window in action: to our knowledge, frontier AI was able to find this vulnerability ahead of attackers, giving defenders time to prepare.
https://openai.com/index/coordinated-disclosure-of-critical-vulnerabilities/

text: Try Grok @Bot, you will love it!

quoted_tweet.author: Robert Scoble
quoted_tweet.text:
I've been GrokBot pilled.

First of all, Grok knows me better than other bots, like Meta Muse, thanks to the 300,000 posts I've done here for 20 years. 

But now that GrokBot @bot can read lists, it opens up powerful new personalized news capabilities. 

I've done this for about a year over on https://alignednews.com -- but last month my X API bill alone was $6,000. 

For a couple of hundred a month you can do the same with lists, either you create, or ones other people have created.

Last night I stuck in my "best in AI" list and had it write me this news page: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1PEfkIbGmvw_SIJJSDvJ-gSbBM5KwXWKVeimiMsQUW-Y/edit?usp=sharing

Every hour my bot reads that list and builds me a new news page. Now I've only put about 10 minutes of effort into this so far. So it's not the prettiest thing you ever have seen, but my bots are working on other ways to present them to me. 

And you can do the same for any topic you care about. You just need to build a list, or find one that's already built and there are millions of lists here on X on literally any topic.

Put your favorite football team onto a list, along with all your favorite journalists or other fans. Then have Grok bot read them for you. 

And that's just the start. You can have it write you a script based on the news, then copy that into, say, @Gemini_Notebook and then you get a podcast, or a video. Based on what people are saying on your topic here on X.

Thank you so much X for making lists far more powerful than they ever were before. Makes the thousands of hours I've put into mine over 20 years so much more useful.

Tips? 

Start small. You can chew through your tokens very quickly. It's amazing how good it is with a small list, like this one, which is what created the page up above: https://x.com/i/lists/1953536336675365173?s=20 (Best AI accounts I've found out of 70,000 here on X).

Don't over hit it. You only need your bot to read the list every hour. Maybe even less. If anything is really important it gets reshared into lists, so the bot doesn't need to hit it often to build you a really great set of things that are important to pay attention to.

I've been begging for this capability for years. THANK YOU X!
